abstract: It has been suggested that the expression of certain heat-shock proteins (HSPs) may be prognostic markers in several tumor types. Since HSPs may be involved in determining cellular sensitivity to chemotherapeutic drugs, the possible relation between HSP expression and cisplatin (cDDP) sensitivity was studied. Three human germ-cell tumor cell lines, 1 human small-cell lung carcinoma (SCLC) cell line and 3 human colon carcinoma cell lines were used as a model for differences in intrinsic cDDP sensitivity. The constitutive expression of a panel of HSPs was studied by immunoblotting. No correlation was found between expression of HSP90, HSP73, HSP72, HSP60 and HSP27 and the extent of intrinsic cDDP sensitivity when all cell lines studied were considered. However, for the 3 cell lines derived from germ-cell carcinomas, HSP27 expression was inversely related to cDDP sensitivity; ie. decreased HSP27 levels were associated with decreased sensitivity. Constitutive HSP expression was also studied in 2 sets of human cell lines with in vitro acquired cDDP resistance. In both resistant cell lines, decreased expression of HSP27 (as determined by Western blotting) was found as compared to the sensitive parent cell lines. Thus, acquired resistance to cDDP was also accompanied by decreased HSP27 expression. Interestingly, when basal HSP27 mRNA levels were measured in the SCLC cell line (GLC4) and its subline with acquired resistance (GLC4-cDDP), no significant differences were detected. Continuous cDDP incubation increased HSP27 levels and induced HSP27 phosphorylation in GLC4 cells, but not in the resistant subline. Thus, although no general relationships between HSP expression and cDDP sensitivity are apparent, high HSP27 expression in vitro relates to high sensitivity to cDDP treatment in some tumor types. This is in accordance with reported clinical data on high HSP27 levels in tumors correlating with good prognosis.
abstract_ja: 熱ショックタンパク質（HSP）の発現は、複数の腫瘍種において予後マーカーとなる可能性が示唆されている。HSPは化学療法薬に対する細胞感受性の決定に関与する可能性があるため、HSP発現とシスプラチン（cDDP）感受性との関係を検討した。細胞内のcDDP感受性の差異をモデル化するため、3種類のヒト胚細胞腫瘍細胞株、1種類のヒト小細胞肺癌（SCLC）細胞株、3種類のヒト大腸癌細胞株を用いた。HSP90、HSP73、HSP72、HSP60、HSP27の恒常的発現をイムノブロットで検討した。対象とした全細胞株を比較すると、これらのHSP発現と固有のcDDP感受性の程度との間に相関は認められなかった。しかし、胚細胞癌由来の3株では、HSP27の発現はcDDP感受性と逆相関していた。すなわち、HSP27レベルの低下は感受性の低下と関連していた。in vitroで獲得したcDDP耐性を持つ2組のヒト細胞株でも、親株と比較して耐性株ではHSP27の発現低下が認められた（ウェスタンブロット）。SCLC細胞株GLC4とその獲得耐性亜株GLC4-cDDPでは、基礎HSP27 mRNAレベルに有意な差は認められなかった。GLC4細胞では持続的なcDDP曝露によりHSP27レベルが上昇し、HSP27のリン酸化も誘導されたが、耐性亜株では認められなかった。以上より、HSP発現と cDDP感受性の間に一般的な関係は見られないものの、in vitroでのHSP27の高発現は一部の腫瘍種においてcDDP治療への高い感受性と関連することが示された。これは、HSP27の高発現が腫瘍中で良好な予後と相関するとの臨床データと一致する。
